top_signals.title: Devon to Sell $4.2 Billon Shale Oil Assets to Crescent Energy
top_signals.summary: Devon Energy Corp. agreed to sell its drilling portfolio in the Eagle Ford shale basin of South Texas to Crescent Energy Co., an oil producer backed by KKR & Co., for about $4.2 billion.

top_signals.title: Ryanair, Lufthansa Say Tough Pilot Checks Still Leave Risks
top_signals.summary: European airlines and regulators can only do so much to deter cockpit attacks like the one during a recent FlyDubai flight, and the aviation industry must accept there’s “no absolute safety and security” even with stringent vetting of pilots.
